title: vLLM-Omni diffusion step state and output/transport validation
summary: Preserve per-request RNG, latent/scheduler state, preparation/final decode, output accumulation and cancel/release ownership across execution modes.

zh-CN.summary: 跨执行模式保持每请求 RNG、潜变量/调度状态、准备与最终解码、输出累积及取消释放职责。

conditions: Identify the actual model protocol, runner capabilities, output fields and producer/consumer contracts.
Check supported execution-mode combinations in the pinned implementation rather than inferring them from method names.

recommendations: Prepare once, isolate request RNG/latent/scheduler state, finalize once and retire state on cancel/failure.
Preserve delta versus snapshot accumulation and correct tensor axes; transport success requires consumer-safe data, not only an enqueued send.
validation_plan: Run relevant step lifecycle, output accumulation, orchestrator abort and connector failure tests, including races and late results.
Exercise actual accelerator/native transport, real-model final media quality and resource growth before matched performance comparisons.
limitations: The engine output enum does not use video as a canonical value; video serving has a separate media contract.
CPU probes and mock transport checks do not certify schema resolution, full-engine execution or native DMA lifetimes.
